rules.title: Power Plan: Ultimate Performance
rules.description: Your power plan should be set to Ultimate Performance or a custom high-performance plan for best gaming results.
rules.failMessage: Power plan is not set to Ultimate Performance. This can throttle CPU clocks.
rules.passMessage: Power plan is set to Ultimate Performance.

rules.title: Windows Game Mode
rules.description: Game Mode prioritizes gaming processes for CPU and GPU resources.
rules.failMessage: Game Mode is not enabled. Enabling it can improve frame consistency.

rules.title: Memory Integrity (VBS)
rules.description: Memory Integrity adds security but reduces gaming performance by 5-10%.
rules.failMessage: Memory Integrity is enabled. This causes measurable FPS loss in games.
rules.passMessage: Memory Integrity is disabled for optimal performance.

rules.title: Hardware-Accelerated GPU Scheduling
rules.description: HAGS reduces latency by letting the GPU manage its own scheduling.
rules.failMessage: HAGS is not enabled. Modern GPUs benefit from hardware scheduling.

rules.title: Interrupt Moderation
rules.description: Disabling interrupt moderation reduces network latency at the cost of slightly higher CPU usage.
rules.failMessage: Interrupt Moderation is enabled. This adds network latency.
rules.passMessage: Interrupt Moderation is disabled for lower latency.

rules.title: TCP Auto-Tuning Level
rules.description: TCP auto-tuning should be set to 'normal' for optimal receive window scaling.
rules.failMessage: TCP auto-tuning is not set to 'normal'. This may limit throughput.

rules.title: Minimum Optimizations Applied
rules.description: At least 5 system tweaks should be applied for a baseline optimization level.
rules.failMessage: Fewer than 5 tweaks applied. Apply more optimizations for better performance.

rules.title: Fast Startup Disabled
rules.description: Fast Startup uses hybrid shutdown which can cause driver issues and stale state.
rules.failMessage: Consider disabling Fast Startup for cleaner boot states.

rules.title: Hibernation Disabled
rules.description: Disabling hibernation frees disk space equal to your installed RAM.
rules.failMessage: Consider disabling hibernation to reclaim disk space.

rules.title: Windows Telemetry Reduced
rules.description: Reducing Windows telemetry lowers background resource usage.
rules.failMessage: Apply privacy tweaks to reduce unnecessary background telemetry.

rules.title: Fullscreen Optimizations Disabled
rules.description: Windows fullscreen optimizations add input lag in many games.
rules.failMessage: Consider disabling fullscreen optimizations for reduced input lag.

rules.title: Nagle's Algorithm Disabled
rules.description: Nagle's algorithm buffers small packets, adding latency to online games.
rules.failMessage: Network packet buffering may be adding latency. Review TCP settings.

rules.title: Premium Features Active
rules.description: Premium users have access to advanced optimizations and priority support.
rules.failMessage: Free tier active. Upgrade for advanced optimizations.

rules.title: Mouse Acceleration Disabled
rules.description: Mouse acceleration makes aiming inconsistent in FPS games.
rules.failMessage: Consider disabling mouse acceleration for consistent aim.

rules.title: Visual Effects Set to Performance
rules.description: Reducing Windows visual effects frees GPU and CPU resources.
rules.failMessage: Consider adjusting visual effects for performance mode.
